digest.component_or_area: doctor lock census / snapshot GC subsystem
propositions: doctor lock census does not probe the snapshot-GC worker lock at <snapshot-store>/gc/worker.lock, leaving stale locks invisible when the GC worker dies between acquire and release
snapshot-GC worker lock uses the same v2 ownership stamp and staleness adjudication as other stamped locks, enabling reuse of doctor's _existence_report without new heuristics
store_root() must not create directories during diagnostic probing to preserve read-only semantics, requiring a non-creating peek_store_root() derivation
snapshot-gc-worker leg must be added to doctor's census with the same held-for/holder/staleness reporting as drain and compact-worker legs
an absent snapshot store should report the leg as free with no finding, matching the behavior of missing lock files on other legs
